title: fagelia scabiosifolia
intro: Fagelia scabiosifolia, commonly known as Fagelia, is a flowering plant species in the family Boraginaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing swelling and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Fagelia include its use in treating various ailments such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems due to its ability to promote sweating, relieve coughs, and ease digestive discomfort. Fagelia contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
